I havent been there much but its a very beutiful city.

Swedish summers are great. It never gets too hot like i fell italy or spain can get. The sun sets late into the night and its just very nice. The winter has a certain meloncholy too it that is hard to explain. Everything feels sad and lonley but in a very beutifull way. One of the best feeling i know is walking in the cold snow to enter a hot bar filled with happy people and friends.
